# FG-CI-0013

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_required_check_of_an_older_merge_result_is_stale_and_blocks_the_merge` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: 必須のチェックが古いマージ結果のものです。対象のブランチが進んだので、新しいマージ結果でのパイプラインが終わるのを待ってからマージしてください。
- en: A required check belongs to an older merge result. The target branch moved: wait for the pipeline on the new merge result to finish, then merge.
- id: Pemeriksaan wajib berasal dari hasil penggabungan yang lama. Cabang tujuan telah bergerak: tunggu pipeline pada hasil penggabungan yang baru selesai, lalu gabungkan.

## 原因 (cause)

M4 C7 (plan 04 M-1 / M-2, ADR-0024 Amendment 2026-11-11): the merge request's first blocking reason is `required_check_stale` — a check the target's merge rule requires has no run on the CURRENT merge result (the merge of the head into the live target tip, `refs/merge-requests/<iid>/merge`, a row of forge.merge_result_refs) but has one on an EARLIER merge result of the same head (the target branch advanced since). A run on an older merge result is stale whatever its conclusion. Precedence per required name: a run on the current merge result counts. Only a name forge itself reports on merge results (`ci/pipeline`, the MR pipeline's) can be stale: its run on an older merge result of the head is stale, and a run on the head never satisfies it (a push pipeline's). For any other name (external reporters: the Checks API accepts only commits a branch or tag reaches) a run on the head counts and a run only an older merge result holds is ignored (missing, never stale: a removed or renamed job never blocks forever). Answered at the merge request (`POST …/merge-requests/{iid}/merge`, nothing written) or inside the merge job under the lock (the attempt is `superseded`, no ref moved); the merge status lists the same reason with `name=<check>`.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `reasons`, `details` (`required_check_stale:name=<check>`), `merge_request_id` and `head_sha`. `gstn mr status --json` shows `merge_result_sha` (the current merge result; null while it is being computed, on a conflict or when the target is gone) and `checks[].stale: true`. forge.merge_result_refs lists the merge results of the head (`target_sha`, `result_sha`, one row per pair); the MR pipeline of the new merge result is `gstn pipeline list --project <id>` (source merge_request, sha = merge_result_sha). The event `forge.review.merge_result_updated` (info) logs every new merge result with `request_id`.

## 対処 (fix)

Nothing to fix in the change: wait for the pipeline forge started on the new merge result (it reports the check on merge_result_sha), or run it again (gstn pipeline retry) if it failed; then merge. If no new merge result appears, the mergeability check is pending or failed (reason mergeability_unknown first; runbook merge-blocked).
